about: Shellz India manufactures and markets mass-market confectionery (baked treats, choco delights, jellies, panned and sugar candies) under the Hugs and Tosca brands, plus food and bakery ingredients and private label supply. Products are made in-house at Delhi and Sonipat (Haryana) and sold through super stockists to kirana stores across about 24 states, with small exports. FY26 revenue was about Rs 192.6 crore.

objects.purpose: Repayment or prepayment of certain outstanding borrowings
General corporate purposes (capped at lower of 15% of gross proceeds or Rs 10 crore)

promoters.background: Kapil Garg has over two decades of experience in consumer packaged foods and has been with the business since inception (incorporated 2012 as Tifosi Foods Pvt Ltd). No promoter shares are pledged.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers were 62.93% of FY26 revenue (44.96% in FY24, 69.18% in Q1FY27); top 5 were 45.88% in FY26. North India gave 75.34% of FY26 revenue.

litigation_note: Past IBC petitions (since withdrawn) and Section 138 NI Act cheque-dishonour complaints by suppliers against the company and promoters; ongoing execution proceedings raised in a complaint by Chawla Printers. Claims not acknowledged as debt were Rs 3.17 crore at Mar-26.
strengths: Mass-market portfolio with most SKUs priced at Rs 10 or below, aimed at repeat impulse purchases.
Revenue grew from Rs 162.4 crore (FY24) to Rs 192.6 crore (FY26); PAT rose from Rs 5.25 crore to Rs 13.37 crore.
EBITDA margin improved from 11.66% to 15.65% and RoNW reached 22.68% in FY26.
Super stockist network reaching kirana stores across about 24 states without a direct salesforce.
All consumer products made in-house at Delhi and Sonipat, with Sonipat expanding capacity.
Debt-equity ratio fell from 2.63x (FY24) to 1.71x (FY26); IPO proceeds earmarked to cut borrowings.
Two brands: mass-market Hugs (about 90% of FY26 revenue) and mass-premium Tosca aimed at e-commerce and quick commerce.
Experienced promoter with over two decades in packaged food.

risks.title: Heavy and rising customer concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 customers contributed 62.93% of FY26 revenue versus 44.96% in FY24, and 69.18% in Q1FY27. There are no long-term agreements; sales rely on purchase orders.

risks.title: High debt and past repayment delays
risks.detail: Outstanding indebtedness was Rs 109.49 crore at June 30, 2026 (sanctioned Rs 112.83 crore); debt-equity 1.71x. Some repayment delays appear in credit history records.

risks.title: Negative operating cash flow in FY26
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was about Rs -11.31 crore in FY26 against Rs 22.11 crore in FY25 and Rs 8.37 crore in FY24, despite Rs 13.37 crore PAT, as inventory and receivables grew.

risks.title: Long working capital cycle
risks.detail: Working capital cycle rose to 171 days in FY26 (from 154 in FY24); inventory days were 175 and Q1FY27 was 197, tying up funds and driving borrowing.

risks.title: Past insolvency and cheque-bounce proceedings
risks.detail: The company faced IBC petitions (withdrawn) and NI Act Section 138 complaints by suppliers against it and promoters; pending suits and an execution matter remain.

risks.title: Regional concentration in North India
risks.detail: North India gave 75.34% of FY26 revenue (79.66% in Q1FY27); Delhi NCR alone was 39.68%.

risks.title: Promoters dominate shareholding
risks.detail: Promoters hold 88.11% pre-issue and will retain control. Shares were bonus-issued 11:1 in October 2025, and the latest preferential issue was at Rs 124.17 per share (bonus adjusted).

risks.title: Consumer-preference and supplier risks
risks.detail: Confectionery tastes shift fast and the company has no long-term supply agreements with most suppliers; past disputes with vendors and supplier-related litigation are disclosed.

notes: Mar-26 is restated consolidated; Mar-24 and Mar-25 are restated standalone. June 2026 quarter (revenue Rs 47.24 crore, PAT Rs 4.08 crore) ignored in arrays. Figures converted from lakhs. Price band, issue size, P/E and post-issue shares are blank in the RHP. Total issue amount not stated; fresh issue is 33,50,400 shares on BSE SME (the market maker portion is 3,29,600 shares). Reservation percentages are the statutory minimums stated for NII and retail. Current ratio computed from balance sheet (current assets / current liabilities). Peer revenue is FY26 consolidated.
